events.name: Google I/O 2026
events.content_hook: Publish 'What Google I/O 2026 means for lockscreen commerce' the morning of May 19. Key angles: Gemini 4.0 upgrade, Android XR glasses, and Google's Universal Commerce Protocol expanding buy buttons into AI Mode and Gemini surfaces. Follow-up piece on Gemini agent implications for D0 discovery feeds.

events.name: The Android Show (Google pre-I/O event)
events.content_hook: Quick pre-I/O briefing post: 'Android Show preview — what Google's mobile AI push means for commerce on the lockscreen.' Sets up the bigger Google I/O content on May 19.

events.name: OpenAI GPT-5.5 Instant & Ad Platform Launch
events.content_hook: Publish 'OpenAI enters advertising: what a self-serve ad platform and GPT-5.5 default mean for commerce discovery.' Angle for Glance: AI feeds competing with lockscreen for first-touch product discovery. Time-sensitive — publish this week (May 8–9).

events.name: AINext Conference Las Vegas
events.content_hook: Publish 'AI deployment trends from AINext: what agentic AI means for retail media and lockscreen commerce' on May 22. Focus on cross-sector agentic AI and commercial deployments — frames Glance as a platform ready for agentic product discovery.

events.name: Amazon New Seller Summit
events.content_hook: Publish 'What Amazon's seller ecosystem growth means for D0 product discovery' on May 19. Angle: Amazon's expanding seller base creates opportunity for pre-discovery surfaces like Glance lockscreen to intercept purchase intent before search.

events.name: LangChain Conference San Francisco
events.content_hook: Publish 'How LLM agent frameworks are reshaping product recommendation pipelines' on May 14. B2B developer audience angle — positions Glance's feed intelligence in context of broader AI engineering trends.

events.name: Apple WWDC 2026
events.content_hook: Publish 'WWDC 2026: Siri 2.0, iOS 27, and what Apple's AI commerce push means for Android lockscreen opportunity' on June 8 keynote morning. Key angles: Siri gaining voice commerce (ordering via DoorDash etc.), Apple's third-party AI model integration (Claude/Gemini/ChatGPT), and new developer APIs for commerce. Strong contrast piece positioning Glance's Android-first advantage.

events.name: CommerceNext Growth Show NYC
events.content_hook: Publish preview post 'CommerceNext 2026: The retail marketing trends shaping D0 commerce' on June 22. 2,700+ retail marketing executives — strong audience alignment with Glance's publisher and brand partners. Post-event wrap on June 24.
events.note: Date is June 23-24, just outside the May 8–June 8 window — include as forward-looking anchor

events.name: CRM & Loyalty Summit (Frisco, TX)
events.content_hook: Publish 'Beyond loyalty points: how lockscreen moments are reshaping retention strategy' on June 1. 700 brand marketers, 200 brands — high relevance to Glance's brand partnership pipeline. Angle: Glance lockscreen as a loyalty-adjacent touchpoint for D0 retention.

events.name: Shopify Q1 2026 Earnings ($100B GMV milestone)
events.content_hook: Publish 'Shopify hits $100B GMV quarter — what merchant scale means for lockscreen commerce' this week (May 8–9). Angle: 34% revenue growth signals mobile-first commerce is accelerating; Glance positioned at the top of the mobile funnel. Reference Shopify's 1M+ merchants on ChatGPT's ACP as proof of agentic commerce convergence.
